# valo-v5-core - Fail-Closed Execution Substrate

> Canonical Role: Fail-closed execution kernel and effect-bound permit/token verification layer.

## Architectural Boundaries

- Core verifies single-use commit tokens and permits immediately before effectors run.
- Core DOES NOT evaluate admissibility or issue clearance (owned by REHT/RACS).
- Core NEVER executes raw callables without valid permit.

## Canonical Invariants

1. Enforcement != Execution
2. Execution != Evaluation
